description:
When to call: before you rely on an MCP server's tools being stable, e.g. you are about to integrate it, pin tool names, or check whether the tool list changed under the same server id.
Returns: dated facts, not a score: first_seen, last_observed, drift_events, n, and observations[] with observation_date, tools_hash, tool_count (may be null), changed. Use trust_score for the derived score and dependency_risk for dependency mortality counts.
Example: {"id":"io.github.06ketan/medium-ops"}
id: MCP schema-server identifier (e.g. io.github.owner/name). Same id space as trust_score.
name: schema_history
